status_summary: The 2024 Safer Communities by Chemical Accident Prevention rule was finalized under the prior administration. On 2026-02-24 EPA published a proposed rule that would rescind certain 2024 provisions and modify others: it would remove safer technology and alternatives analysis requirements for existing processes, either rescind third-party audits or limit them to facilities with two or more accidents in five years, and keep the public data tool in a more controlled form limited to county-level searches without mapping, citing security concerns and drawing on the reasoning of the 2019 reconsideration rule. EPA estimated net annualized cost savings of about 235 to 242 million dollars. The comment period was extended to 2026-05-11, and no final rule was found in the Federal Register through 2026-10-13.

timeline.event: EPA published a proposed rule revising the 2024 Risk Management Program amendments, including information availability, third-party audits and safer technology analysis.
EPA extended the comment period on the proposal to 2026-05-11.
